multilabel_metrics.reason: TCM-SD is single-label multiclass (one norm_syndrome per row).

model.inspired_by: Chen et al. 2024 TCM-BERT-CNN (Integrative Medicine Research)

holdout_policy.note: Same train/validation partitions as RF / LR / SVM / Huang CNN.

from_paper: Clinical symptom text as model input
Precision / recall / F1 emphasized under imbalance
adaptations: Frozen compact Chinese BERT-family encoder (hfl/rbt3) with online forwards (full embedding cache OOMs on CPU; not end-to-end bert-base-chinese finetune)
148-way Softmax multiclass head (not Softmax exterior/interior & deficiency/excess pairs + Sigmoid 17-label group)
TCM-SD clinical records instead of guideline/textbook expert-knowledge corpus
Project 70/10/20 validation protocol instead of 10-fold CV
chen_mapping.why_not_gong: Gong et al. 2023 ML-PRDF requires multi-label syndrome targets and a binary symptom matrix; TCM-SD is single-label multiclass free text, so multi-label deep forest cannot be implemented faithfully here.
chen_mapping.not_claimed: Exact numerical reproduction of Chen et al. TCM-BERT-CNN results
